Missions Artemis I NASA successfully completed an uncrewed test flight of the SLS (Space Launch System) rocket and Orion spacecraft in Nov. 2022. This mission marked the first launch of the rocket using new exploration ground systems and evaluated Orion’s systems without astronauts or the critical life support systems planned for future crewed missions.
